comment: The declarative schema ladder (REQ-004, criterion arch/registry-in-data v5).
This file is the catalog: order, from/to, stable id, repository-relative SQL
script path and apply-handler tag of every rung live in DATA. Adding a schema
version = append a record here plus its .sql file; build.rs bakes the record
and the script content into the binary and fails the build when the ladder is
not continuous from 1. `open()` is a generic executor that knows no rung name.
`apply` selects the rung's BEHAVIOR: "script" means run the SQL verbatim and
needs no code; any other tag resolves at runtime against RUNG_APPLIERS in
src/lib.rs — the documented code/data boundary for rungs pure SQL cannot
express (observe pre-mutation state, write repair events).
